jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists/activists with regional expertise, not a recent graduate, and reads as a voluntary/advisory position with no vacancy for the candidate. The human-rights and securitisation subject is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: IATF Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Ineligible: this is a "Lead" role requiring a mandatory Certified IATF 16949 Lead Auditor qualification and proven substantial experience conducting third-party audits, none of which the candidate holds. The automotive quality-assurance field is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: IMS Auditor
jobs.reason: Requires a registered IRCA (or equivalent) Lead Auditor qualification, substantial third-party ISO auditing experience, and at least two years managing environmental/safety compliance — essentials the candidate does not meet. It is also an environmental/safety compliance auditing role wholly outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Policy Research Intern
jobs.reason: This is an internship, which is excluded by policy, and it additionally requires excellent written and verbal Chinese as an essential — a language the candidate does not have. The academic-publishing focus is only tangentially interesting.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Solutions Business Analyst
jobs.reason: Director-level title requiring deep subject-matter expertise in global financial regulation and substantial senior experience — well beyond entry-level and a hard mismatch. The role also demands specialised financial-regulatory and strong data-science/coding skills the candidate does not possess, and it sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Client Support Advisor - kaufmännischer Mitarbeiter
jobs.reason: The role explicitly requires "many years of experience" in a client-facing/customer support role plus proven experience managing complex service delivery and ERP/CRM systems like SAP — an experience level the candidate does not meet. It is also a commercial client-support/administrative position wholly outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical AI engineering role whose essential requirements — building LLM solutions, fine-tuning foundation models, writing production-quality Python, and solid ML theory — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-ML skill set. It is a genuine software/ML engineering position, not a research or policy role, and falls on the wrong side of the candidate's technical limits.

jobs.title: Senior Researcher - A Healthy Life
jobs.reason: The "Senior Researcher" level and pay band signal a role beyond entry-level, and the essential requirements centre on end-to-end statistical modelling and Python/R analysis of large datasets plus project/programme management — a substantial skills gap against the candidate's analysis-level, SPSS-oriented quantitative background. The health-innovation topic also sits outside the core interest zones.
